title: feat(ui): every menu row is a tile: objects in their colour, everything else on a light grey tile
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuFFKDUEw658BkLsJjATrqG7)_

Part of #36141

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWopgUHAVkDYdjqW8g

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The widening: `@object-ui/components` exports `NeutralIconTile`, its props type `NeutralIconTileProps` and `NEUTRAL_ICON_TILE_CLASS`; `@object-ui/layout` exports `NAV_KIND_ICON` and `resolveNavKindIcon`. Nothing is removed or renamed, and no `packages/spec` path is touched.

`Part of`, not `Fixes`: the card's item 4 (an automatic colour for an object with none) is on the maintainer's decision card and is not in this branch. This PR delivers items 1–3 and 5–7.

## What changes

The rule, from the card: colour only says which object a row is, never which kind of menu entry it is, and every row draws the same tile.

1. **Non-object menu entries are tiles.** In the sidebar (`NavigationRenderer`) and the `nav:menu` page block, a `dashboard`, `report`, `page`, `url`, `component`, `doc` or `action` entry draws `NeutralIconTile`: the object tile's size, corners and glyph size, a light grey square with a dark grey glyph (`gray-200` / `gray-700`, swapped in the dark theme). The glyph is the entry's own `icon`, else its kind's (`NAV_KIND_ICON`: `layout-dashboard`, `chart-column`, `file`, `external-link`, `layout-grid`, `book-open`, `zap`). No kind has a colour of its own.
2. **Object entries** keep their object's tile (white glyph on the object's palette colour), unchanged.
3. **An object entry that opens a view** (`viewName`, e.g. "My Deals") is its object's tile; pinned.
5. Group headings and separators draw no tile; pinned.
6. **Recent, Favorites and Starred** in the sidebar, and Home's **Recently accessed**: a row about an object (the object, one of its views, one of its records) draws that object's tile in its icon and colour; a dashboard, page, report or Studio item draws the neutral tile with its kind's icon. The emoji those rows drew (📊 📈 📄 📋) are gone. `ContentItemTile` (app-shell, not exported) holds the rule for the sidebar; Home's row reads the same object metadata it already read for records.
7. **Phone app home menu** is the same `NavigationRenderer` (`renderAppMenu('home')`), so it follows with no code of its own; see the phone shots under Verification.

## Why

The sidebar mixed solid colour squares (objects) with bare outline icons (everything else) in one column, which read as two weights. The maintainer asked what the non-object entries are and what colour they should take; the answer agreed was one light grey tile for all of them (card body, 「同意，立卡」).

## Verification

- Unit: `components` `object-icon-tile-35985.test.tsx` (neutral tile: one value per theme, glyph contrast ≥ 4.5:1 both themes, lighter than every palette square, same shape as the object tile at all four sizes); `layout` `NavigationRenderer.objectTile-35985.test.tsx` (every non-object kind, an action and a row inside a group on the neutral tile; a view on its object's colour; group heading and separator draw none; kind glyphs); app-shell `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx` (object and record favourites are object tiles, a dashboard favourite neutral, no emoji; a Recent record object tile, a Recent metadata item neutral). Flipped pins: the 30126 controls (a dashboard with no icon now draws its kind's glyph, still never the object's), the 12604 Home rows (view and object rows now draw the object's tile), and four sidebar label lists that read the emoji as text.
- Local, against `f5553525`: those files plus every app-shell / console test that mounts the sidebar, Home or `nav:menu` (119 files, 1,168 tests) pass; `type-check` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/app-shell` clean; `eslint` on the changed files 0 errors.
- Browser: HotCRM (hotcrm main `1468877`, `objectstack dev`), console `vite` from this branch, Sales app, 1440 and 375, light and dark, before and after, in the project thread's evidence folder (`build-seat1/36141/`): `*-sidebar-*`, `*-sidebar-recent-*`, `*-home-recent-*`, `*-phone-app-home-*`. After: every Sales sidebar row is a 20px rounded tile (24px on the phone); Home, Sales Home, Sales Performance, Product Catalog, Inbox, Sales Activity and CRM Overview sit on the light grey tile; the object rows are unchanged. HotCRM declares no object colour, so its object tiles are all the neutral `gray` palette square; that is item 4's question, not this PR's.

- Review delta `5c70f68e` (L2 S1, N1, N2, N6 on `eb36a397`): the sidebar's Recent, Favorites and Starred rows ask the objects they name in ONE batched presence read (`readRecentObjects`, moved out of `HomePage.tsx` into `console/home/readRecentObjects.ts` and re-exported there); a name not answered served draws the object tile in its neutral colour and is never read by name. Pinned in `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx` ("never asks a missing one by name"), which fails with the gate removed (4 by-name calls name the missing object). `CONTENT_KIND_ICON` spreads `NAV_KIND_ICON`; `NavIconTarget`'s comment names the kind icon; the neutral-tile pin compares it with every palette square. Local: 180 affected files / 2,021 tests pass, app-shell type-check clean, eslint 0 errors.

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)

- Item 4 (automatic colour) waits on the maintainer's decision card. If it is chosen it lands as its own commit on this branch with its own spec, changeset and L2 face.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
